visualCharacteristics: Centered tab labels with a green underline on the active tab; clicking switches the panel; panel splits text (H2, paragraph, arrow link) left and an autoplay muted looping video in a dark rounded frame right, with a pause toggle.
contentPattern: Tabs: Get Design Ideas / Discover Materials / Save And Share / Make It Real; panels: 'Explore instant home inspiration' (+ Try on your home link), 'Customize every detail', 'Get feedback on your designs', 'Find a pro and get quotes' (+ Request a quote link); each with an autoplay mp4 video (james-hardie.bynder.com)
usage: Tabbed feature showcase: each tab shows text (heading, paragraph, link) beside an autoplaying muted video or an image.
reuseGuidance: One row per tab: tab label | content with heading, text, optional link and a link to an .mp4 video (or a picture). Only the active tab's video plays, and only while on screen.
structure: One row per tab: label | heading, paragraph, link, video link or picture
